'''Esm Arkhee''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] who worked for the [[Force Adept|Force adept]] [[Pal-Nada]] at some point during [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] history.

==Biography==
Esm Arkhee was a weak-minded [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]], which allowed the [[Cerean/Legends|Cerean]] [[Force Adept|Force adept]] [[Pal-Nada]] to use [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to control the Twi'lek. The Cerean used Arkhee to assist him in a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] theft operation and on one occasion, while under his master's control, Arkhee approached a group of agents and by representing himself as a member of the front organization [[Interplanetary Acquisitions]], he lured the agents into accompanying him to a [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]] while the [[Quarren/Legends|Quarren]] thief [[Shurgg]] attempted to steal the agents' ship.<ref name="Steal of a Deal" />

Arkhee later became a resident of the [[Blinders district]] of the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Sahl-Evin]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Jenenma]], a region of the city that was controlled by Pal-Nada. The agents later tracked Pal-Nada to Jenenma and Arkhee was present in the [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] [[The Hutt's Last Laugh]] during a confrontation between the agents and the [[Gamorrean/Legends|Gamorrean]] pit-fighter [[Tarkil Hroka]]. The Twi'lek sat on a bench and watched the fight expectantly.<ref name="Put Up Your Dukes">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20021107dukes|text=Put Up Your Dukes|int=Put Up Your Dukes}}</ref>

==Personality and traits==
Arkhee was cowardly and weak-willed, allowing Pal-Nada control of the Twi'lek.<ref name="Steal of a Deal" />

==Equipment==
When meeting a group of agents, Arkhee was dressed in expensive robes.<ref name="Steal of a Deal" />
